limitations: Both synchronous APIs use the existing operation/Future/native pools. ACCEPTED reports admission, not successful execution; even XWAIT_ERROR transfers the accepted possibly-pending Future. Native-wait failure is injected only in caller-side selected single tests, not a claimed real OS wait failure.

Explicit-slot selection does not require a catalogue. Metadata calls preserve complete typed preflight and explicit keyless policy. No automatic catalogue acquisition/replacement, authorized exotic-command assistance, replica policy or new accepted-business replay is implemented.

Operation entry precedes sync gates/aliases/metadata and propagates through native deadlines. No second wait timeout. Other threads can Close; cancellation uses existing async APIs. Blocking is refused on both active progress and node-cache Engines, including other workers. Application dependencies on unrelated Engines remain caller-owned.
Local timeout/close outcomes do not join native FIFO/writes. Separate Nodes/Engine physical retirement remains required. Caller-held outcomes survive all those owners.

Real Redis tests are owned plaintext IPv4 Cluster; no real TLS/auth/trust/replica/process-death acceptance. Original seed denial is policy injection with administrative pools retained. Windows clients use WSL-hosted Redis; WSL is not native Linux production acceptance.

Performance compares one outstanding valid warm binary GET with explicit async+Wait/sync and metadata async+Wait/sync on the same binary/config/peers/native Engines/Future. Sync adds both-Engine checks and full output-span validation. Setup/bootstrap/catalogue/sample buffers are excluded. Separate global heap samples include overlapping native tails. No zero-overhead claim.

One warmup/seven rotated serial unpinned samples, original3% MAD/6% central-range noise gates and measured clock-resolution bounds. No retries for noise qualification. Closed-loop observations do not establish fixed-arrival/contention/upstream/TLS/CPU/RSS/native Linux or>=72h production/performance acceptance. All four products remain developing.
